{{Infobox auto}}
'''Clear mushroom soup''' is a [[food]] that heals {{Value|Clear Mushroom Soup|heals}} and is eaten in {{Value|Clear Mushroom Soup|eat_time}}. It is crafted from a [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushroom]], and it is also what a mooshroom gives when milked with a bowl, in place of the [[chocolate]] that the renamed mushroom stew would be.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/mushroom_soup.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dried kelp, a carrot, a braised mushroom and a bowl, in any arrangement. Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks the recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/braised_brown_mushroom.json}}</ref>

=== Milking a mooshroom ===
Using a bowl on a mooshroom runs an advancement that gives the player a clear mushroom soup and then clears the plain mushroom stew the bowl produced.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/milked_mooshroom.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/mooshroom_milking/replace_chocolate_with_soup.mcfunction}}</ref> The pack turns the vanilla mushroom stew into chocolate, so without this step a mooshroom would be a source of chocolate.

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Clear Mushroom Soup|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Clear Mushroom Soup|heals}}. It has no other effect, and the bowl is returned.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/matcha/mushroom_soup.json}}</ref>
